title: Clear the last four surfaces still teaching the retired cost tiers
action: Slice 7 residue, named precisely by the mrs-21 worker after it rewrote the main rubric in commit c532502a: four surfaces still teach the three cost tiers, and they were outside that cell's declared files. They are worker-details.md:7 (lists model tier among a dispatch's inputs, plus a Trace Field Tiers By Lane heading), docs/04-skills-spec.md:143, docs/01-distillation.md:38 and :146, and docs/knowledge/areas/doctrine-layer/delegation-threshold.md:83. This is dead text teaching a rubric that no longer exists — bee cells tier is gone in all four directions and the cell field is role. READ swarming-reference.md FIRST: mrs-21 already rewrote the canonical rubric there, so your job is to make these four agree with it, not to invent a second wording. What is true: role is required on a cell and is any non-empty name, validation checks presence and shape and never membership; the recommended words code, read, test, docs, design are GUIDANCE; a dispatch asks an ordered list ending in the historical name so no existing host changes model; an unconfigured role falls through and WARNS; escalation is bee cells escalate --id <id> [--reason <text>] [--off] with the 40 percent ration; bee status --json renames tier_mix to role_mix. ONE DELIBERATE EXCEPTION, do not touch it: the phrase down-tier as DELEGATION ALTITUDE (fan the gathering out down-tier) is AGENTS.md's own language for delegating a mechanical step to a cheaper worker, and it survives the model-role split untouched. mrs-21 kept it in gates-and-delegation.md on purpose. Distinguish cost-TIER-the-retired-selector from down-tier-the-delegation-verb and leave the latter alone; if a line is genuinely ambiguous, say so on the cap rather than guessing. Do NOT hand-edit the mirror trees; run bee dev regen and let it write them, then bee dev release-manifest --check.
verify: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml devtools && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check
